en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town street running along a hillside. On the right, a stone retaining wall with railings leads up to a large church-like building with a steep gabled roof and a tall, slender tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and spire. Modest houses with steep tiled roofs stand along the road further back. Wooden and stone fences line the street, and there are a few pedestrians. Utility poles with insulators suggest early electrification. Trees cover the hill in the background.
